description: Op-shaped job that walks the live Dagster asset graph and POSTs the raw payload to any HTTP webhook (Slack, internal endpoint, n8n, Zapier). Optional Bearer auth.

tags.label: Job Tags
tags.description: Dagster job tags as key-value pairs.

webhook_url.label: Webhook URL
webhook_url.description: Full webhook URL to POST the lineage payload to.

api_token_env.label: API Token Env Var
api_token_env.description: Optional env var with a Bearer token. Omit for unauthenticated webhooks.

only_export_on_change.label: Only Export on Change
only_export_on_change.description: Hash the structural payload and skip push when unchanged from the previous successful run.

fail_on_webhook_error.label: Fail on Webhook Error
fail_on_webhook_error.description: If true, fail the run when the webhook is unreachable or returns an error. Default true.
